runtime_choices.display_carveout: off on tp4-ring, tp4..8-switched, and tp1 (SPARK_DS41F_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS=0); RM scanout carve-out via nvidiactl on tp3-* and tp2-* (=1; 0821)
runtime_choices.indexer_split: under SP prefill; hardware e2m1x2 indexer/mxfp4 quantize (0777) and fused sink/sparse-MLA indexer front tuning (0808, 0813, 0817)
